name: MsoCustomXMLValidationErrorType
description: Indicates how validation errors will be cleared or generated.

constants.name: msoCustomXMLValidationErrorSchemaGenerated
constants.description: Specifies that where there is a non-empty schema collection available for the custom XML part and validation is in effect, any changes to the part will cause validation errors.

constants.name: msoCustomXMLValidationErrorAutomaticallyCleared
constants.description: Specifies that the error will clear itself whenever any change is made to the node it is bound to.

constants.name: msoCustomXMLValidationErrorManual
constants.description: Specifies that the error will not be cleared until the Delete method is called.
